Hi @AseemPrasad,

I wanted to provide some context regarding the recent pull requests.

Many of these issues were analyzed and resolved together because they were interconnected and involved overlapping files and code paths. To ensure that no work was lost, I first consolidated all the fixes into a backup branch and then created separate issue-specific branches and pull requests from that work so that each GitHub issue could be tracked and reviewed individually.

As a result, some of the PRs may appear to contain related or overlapping changes, but each PR corresponds to a specific issue that was addressed as part of the overall fix set.

If possible, I would appreciate it if the PRs could be evaluated based on the issue resolutions they represent, since the underlying work was completed before being separated into individual branches for easier review and issue tracking.

The backup branch containing the complete set of changes is:

`backup/all-remaining-fixes`

I completely understand if any adjustments or consolidation are needed, and I am happy to provide clarification on any specific PR or issue.

Thank you for your time, review, and for maintaining the project.

This PR expands concurrency and robustness across the vector store, HTTP idempotency, and E2EE key rotation workflows by introducing parallel shard search, canonical request fingerprinting with replay waiting, and verifiable/audited wrapped-master-key rotation. **Changes:** - Parallelize `ShardedVectorStore.search()` across shards and add `search_async()`. - Improve idempotency-key behavior: canonical JSON body fingerprinting + brief wait-for-result to enable concurrent replay. - Add E2EE wrapped master key envelopes, rotation verification/audit logging, and KMS key identifiers; add/extend tests for these behaviors. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `core/vector_store.py` | Adds parallel shard search and async search support. | | `core/embedding_engine.py` | Makes the vector store singleton thread-safe and reinitializes on shape changes. | | `api/middlewares/idempotency.py` | Canonicalizes request body hashing and waits briefly for concurrent response caching. | | `api/idempotency.py` | Extends HTTP key construction and adds a polling-based wait for cached responses. | | `core/e2ee.py` | Introduces wrapped key envelope format, rotation auditing, and post-rotation verification/rollback. | | `core/kms.py` | Adds a stable `key_id` for `LocalFileKMS` instances. | | `tests/test_vector_store_rebalance.py` | Adds tests for parallel shard fan-out and vector store reinit on config changes. | | `tests/test_http_idempotency.py` | Adds a concurrent idempotency replay test and improves FakeRedis thread-safety. | | `tests/test_e2ee_rotation.py` | Adds rotation/verification compatibility test for wrapped master keys. |
